### Foundations of the Faith: What It Means to Be a Disciple of Christ
Author: J. Oswald Sanders
Site: Decision Magazine
URL: https://billygraham.org/decision-magazine/articles/foundations-of-the-faith-what-it-means-to-be-a-disciple-of-christ
Passage: Luke 14:25-33
Points:
- True discipleship requires deliberate obedience and lifelong commitment rather than impulsive, temporary enthusiasm.
- Love for Christ must be supreme, surpassing every earthly relationship and personal attachment.
- Carrying one's cross involves voluntary self-denial, sacrificial suffering, and enduring worldly rejection.
- Following Jesus demands surrender of all possessions, viewing oneself as a trustee rather than an owner.
